**Objectives of the Tutorial/Lab**
By the end of this tutorial, you should be able to:

- Explain overdispersion and fit Poisson regression models using quasilikelihood.
- Understand the effect of quasilikelihood on model estimates.
- Simulate samples from mixture models and do classification.
